message.anime_multiverse.mega.rift.lever: The lever is down. The vault is open already.
The lever is stiff: the vault answers to the guardian's fall or the plates. It gives in %s s.
A lever clicks somewhere in the realm... iron grinds: the bars of the vault lift.
message.anime_multiverse.mega.rift.welco: [Realm] The vault behind the Hall is barred. %s Or pull the RELEASE LEVER in the small chamber north of the Hall: it gives in %s s, and the bars lift by themselves in %s s. The exit rift is behind you.
message.anime_multiverse.mega.rift.lever: A lever clicks somewhere in the realm: the release lever north of the Hall gives way now.
The old mechanism gives way by itself: the bars of the vault lift.
message.anime_multiverse.mega.pocket.for: The tomb is forming behind the tear (%s%%). Wait here: you are taken in the moment it stands.
The tomb behind the tear is coming down. There is nothing to enter.
message.anime_multiverse.mega.pocket.wel: [Tomb] The treasury behind the master's lair is sealed. It answers to %s magic, to the %s, to force, and to the SEAL LEVER on the wall of the key room: the lever gives in %s s, or the moment the master falls, and the seal opens by itself in %s s. The exit rift is in this hall.
message.anime_multiverse.mega.pocket.lev: The lever is down. The seal is open already.
The lever is stiff: the master of the tomb still holds the seal. It gives in %s s, or when the master falls.
A lever clicks somewhere in the tomb... and the seal of the treasury falls away.
A lever clicks somewhere in the tomb: the seal lever in the key room gives way now.
